question: Change the CreateTraces receiver factory function signature to include a new logger parameter: CreateTraces(ctx context.Context, set Settings, cfg component.Config, logger *zap.Logger, next consumer.Traces) (Traces, error). All receiver factories must update their signatures.

files_to_modify.why: Core file defining the CreateTracesFunc type (function type alias), the Factory interface with CreateTraces method, the factory struct's createTraces method implementation, and the WithTraces option function. The CreateTracesFunc type must add logger *zap.Logger parameter, the Factory interface CreateTraces method must add the parameter, and the factory.createTraces method must thread the logger through to the stored function. A new import for go.uber.org/zap is required.
files_to_modify.section: L56-114 (CreateTracesFunc type, Factory interface), L115-179 (factory.createTraces method), L180-216 (WithTraces option)

files_to_modify.why: Extended factory wrapping the base receiver.Factory. Its WithTraces function wraps receiver.CreateTracesFunc and its factory struct delegates to the base. Must update WithTraces to thread the new logger parameter through the wrapped CreateTracesFunc.
files_to_modify.section: L78-115 (WithTraces, WithMetrics, WithLogs factory option functions)

files_to_modify.why: OTLP receiver factory implementation. The createTraces function (L69-89) is passed to receiver.WithTraces and must add logger *zap.Logger to its signature.
No-op receiver factory. The createtraces function (L27-42) is passed to xreceiver.WithTraces and must add logger *zap.Logger to its signature.
Test no-op receiver factory. The createtraces function (L44-58) is passed to xreceiver.WithTraces and must add logger *zap.Logger to its signature.
Sample receiver factory for mdatagen tool. The createtraces function (L31-59) is passed to xreceiver.WithTraces and must add logger *zap.Logger to its signature.
Sample factory receiver for mdatagen tool. The createtraces function (L33-60) is passed to xreceiver.WithTraces and must add logger *zap.Logger to its signature.
Example receiver implementation demonstrating a traces receiver factory. The createExampleReceiver function (L104-115) is used as a CreateTracesFunc and must add logger *zap.Logger to its signature.

Unit tests for receiver factory. The mock createtraces function (L83-95) must update its signature. Test functions TestNewFactory and TestNewFactoryWithOptions (L25-71) that call factory.CreateTraces must pass a logger argument.
Unit tests for xreceiver factory. Tests using WithTraces may need to update mock function signatures and CreateTraces call sites to include logger parameter.
Unit test for nop receiver factory. TestNewNopFactory calls CreateTraces on the factory and must pass the new logger parameter.
Contract checker test utility that calls factory.CreateTraces via the Factory interface. Must pass a logger when invoking CreateTraces in the test scenario runner.

new_dependencies: go.uber.org/zap - Required in receiver/receiver.go for the *zap.Logger parameter type in CreateTracesFunc and Factory interface
answer.summary: Changing the CreateTraces signature requires modifying 16 files in the opentelemetry-collector repo. The core change is in receiver/receiver.go where the CreateTracesFunc type, Factory interface, and factory struct method must all add the logger *zap.Logger parameter. The xreceiver wrapper in receiver/xreceiver/receiver.go must thread the parameter through. Five receiver factory implementations (otlpreceiver, nopreceiver, receivertest nop, samplereceiver, samplefactoryreceiver) and the example_test.go must update their createtraces functions to accept the new parameter. Six test files must update both mock function signatures and call sites where CreateTraces is invoked to pass the logger. The contract_checker.go test utility must also pass a logger when invoking CreateTraces through the Factory interface.
